scenario: Tolerance is logical-only ([LGRA.5.9.5] / [LFAC.2.6.4]; DS has no ttl tolerance): a `tolerance`-annotated slot on a `ttl`-scoped schema is a compile error. TTL/event facts are deadline-driven and carry no identity, so they do not dedup — there is no within-tolerance reassertion to suppress. Pin: a `ttl`-scoped schema with a `tolerance`-annotated Float slot is rejected with DS_VALIDATE_TOLERANCE_TTL_SCHEMA.
rules_ds:
schema Measurement scope ttl 5_min:
    entity_id: String
    temp: Float tolerance 0.5

rule warm:
    Measurement m where m.temp > 20.0
->
    log info "warm"
